raw:
The user wants me to write UI strings for a player app in Traditional Chinese (繁體中文). The scenario: a user taps to open a recorded video content but it cannot play because the file format is not supported.

Requirements:
- "s1": error message (one sentence)
- "s2": button on the error screen
- "s3": name of this feature area at the top of the screen

Output only a JSON object with keys s1, s2, s3, values as strings, no other text.

Let me think about appropriate Traditional Chinese strings:

s1 (error message, one sentence): Something like "抱歉，此檔案格式不支援，無法播放。" or "此檔案格式不支援，無法播放。" — one sentence, polite. Could also be "很抱歉，此檔案格式不支援播放。" Hmm, "一句" means one sentence. Let me make it: "此檔案格式不支援，無法播放。" That's one sentence technically (with comma). Or "抱歉，此錄影檔的格式不支援，無法播放。"

Consider "畫面內容" — recorded screen/video content. The error message could be: "此影片格式不支援，無法播放。"

s2 (button): Typical button on error screen: "確定" (OK), "知道了", "返回", "重試" (Retry). Since the file format isn't supported, retry wouldn't help much, but apps often still provide "重試" or "返回". A common choice: "好" / "確定" / "返回" / "關閉". I'd go with "確定" or "返回上一頁". Perhaps "知道了" is friendly. For a player app error screen, "確定" is safe. Or "返回" to go back. I'll choose "確定".

Actually maybe "重試" would be odd since format unsupported won't fix on retry. "確定" to dismiss is better. Or "返回". I'll go with "確定".

s3 (name of the feature area at the top of the screen): This is tricky. "畫面頂端這個功能區的名稱" — the feature area at the top of the screen. For a player app viewing recorded content, the top area could be a header/title bar. What would it be called? Possibly "播放器" (Player), "媒體中心", "我的錄影", "最近播放", "影片庫"? Hmm.

Given the app is a player app and the user opens a recorded screen content (錄好的畫面內容 — recorded screen/video), the top feature area might be like "媒體播放" or "影片播放". Maybe it's a navigation section name in the app: like "播放" tab or "媒體庫" or "我的影片".

This seems like a localization test set design — s1, s2, s3 are strings: error message, button, and section header. The "功能區" at top could be a header bar naming the screen: e.g., "影片播放" (Video Playback) or "播放器" or "錄影播放".

I think "媒體播放" or "影片播放" works. Since content is "錄好的畫面" (screen recordings), maybe "螢幕錄影" or "錄影播放"? The user opens "一段錄好的畫面內容" — a recorded screen content. This could be screen recording. So the top area could be named "錄影" or "螢幕錄影" or "我的錄影".

Hmm, ambiguous. Safest: "媒體播放" maybe too generic. Alternatively "影片" tab. Let me think: In an app, when you open a recorded video, the top may show the section like "播放" or "影片播放". I'll go with "影片播放".

Actually, could be the app's player feature name: "播放器". As a feature area name, "播放器" seems plausible too.

I'll pick "影片播放" for clarity.

Hmm, but if the content is a screen recording, "影片播放" is still fine since recordings are videos.

Let me finalize:

s1: "此檔案格式不支援，無法播放。" — one sentence. Could add apology: "很抱歉，此檔案格式不支援，無法播放。" One sentence with comma is fine. I'll keep it concise: "此檔案格式不支援，無法播放。"

Actually "一句" — one sentence. Having a comma-separated clause is still one sentence. Fine.

s2: "確定"

s3: "影片播放"

Output JSON only:

{"s1": "此檔案格式不支援，無法播放。", "s2": "確定", "s3": "影片播放"}

No code fences? The instruction says "只輸出一個 JSON 物件...不要其他文字" — output only a JSON object, no other text. So no code fences, just raw JSON. I'll output raw JSON.</think>{"s1": "此檔案格式不支援，無法播放。", "s2": "確定", "s3": "影片播放"}
